# Amrutha Reddy Konala

> Amrutha Reddy Konala is a strategic advisor, fractional CMO and the author of Structural Marketing: The 9 Pillar Operating System, a 10-volume work that treats marketing as one structure: competition, strategy, customer, value, pricing, channels, timing, execution and measurement.

Amrutha Reddy Konala (she) is based in Hyderabad, India and works with founders, family enterprises and leadership teams in India and worldwide. She leads a small team for writing, design, video and distribution. Role: Strategic Advisor · Fractional CMO · Creative Director · Author.

Structural Marketing: The 9 Pillar Operating System is her method and her 10-volume work (2026, 4,614 pages). It is not the same as "structural marketing" in Lee, Kozlenkova and Palmatier (2015), which concerns organisational structure as a marketing tool. The Marketing Operating System (MOS) is separate software she is designing and building; it is in development.

## Services and prices

For owner-led and mid-size companies of roughly ₹50–1,000 Cr revenue (about $6M–120M), in India and abroad. Size bands: S = ₹50–100 Cr revenue; M = ₹100–500 Cr revenue; L = ₹500–1,000 Cr revenue. India prices are in rupees, plus GST as applicable; prices outside India are in US dollars. Fixed prices, no discounts: a smaller budget gets a smaller scope.

- [Strategy session](https://amruthareddykonala.github.io/strategy-session/): 90 minutes with me, then a written note on the three things to fix first. India ₹25,000; outside India $750.
- [Marketing Audit](https://amruthareddykonala.github.io/marketing-audit/): The whole marketing system, all nine pillars, in two to three weeks: a written diagnosis and a 90-day plan. India ₹2L / ₹3.5L / ₹5L; outside India $5k / $8k / $12k.
- [Sprint](https://amruthareddykonala.github.io/marketing-sprint/): One big problem, diagnosed, designed and built with your team in three to six weeks. India ₹4L / ₹6L / ₹8L; outside India $9k / $14k / $18k.
- [Fractional CMO](https://amruthareddykonala.github.io/fractional-cmo-india/): A senior marketing leader one or two days a week, accountable for the plan, the team and the numbers. India ₹2.5L / ₹4.5L a month (1 / 2 days a week); outside India $6k / $10k a month (1 / 2 days a week).
- [Fractional CMO outside India](https://amruthareddykonala.github.io/fractional-cmo/): remote, $6,000 / $10,000 a month.

- Marketing Strategy & Competitive Position: Where you can win and against whom, what you will stop doing, and a marketing strategy your team can act on. ₹1.5L / ₹2.25L / ₹3L; outside India $3.5k / $5k / $7k.

- Ideal Customer Profile & Segment Plan: Which customers create the most value, how to find and qualify them, and which ones to stop chasing. ₹1.5L / ₹2.25L / ₹3L; outside India $3.5k / $5k / $7k.
- Pricing Strategy Review: How much pricing power you have, where price leaks away (discounts, schemes, channels), and what to change first. ₹1.5L / ₹2.25L / ₹3L; outside India $3.5k / $5k / $7k.

- Launch & New-Market Entry Plan: Whether you are ready, what must be true first, the order of moves, and a 90-day launch plan. India entry for foreign brands too. ₹1.5L / ₹2.25L / ₹3L; outside India $3.5k / $5k / $7k.
- Marketplace & Quick-Commerce Economics Review (outside India: Channel & Distributor Review): What each channel really costs and earns, how dependent you are on it, and the channel mix to move to. ₹1.5L / ₹2.25L / ₹3L; outside India $3.5k / $5k / $7k.
- Marketing Budget & Board Investment Case: A marketing P&L, a budget rebuilt from zero, and an investment case your CFO and board can test. ₹2L / ₹3.5L / ₹5L; outside India $5k / $8k / $12k.
- SME IPO & IPO Equity Story: Investor Narrative: The equity story investors can believe, the leadership message house, and a consistent communication record before you file; a consistency review with your lead manager once you have filed; a post-listing plan. ₹4L / ₹6L / ₹8L; India only.

## The nine pillars

- COMPETE: Where can we win, and against whom?
- WHY: What are we choosing, and what are we refusing?
- WHO: Which customers create value worth serving?
- WHAT: What do we promise, and how do we prove it?
- HOW MUCH: How do we price and capture the value we create?
- WHERE: Where do customers find, buy and use it?
- WHEN: When do we move, and in what order?
- HOW: How does the organisation actually execute?
- SO WHAT: What did it produce, in the language of the P&L?

## The ten volumes

- [Structural Marketing: COMPETE](https://amruthareddykonala.github.io/books/sm-volume-1-compete/): Power dynamics, game theory, moat physics
- [Structural Marketing: WHY](https://amruthareddykonala.github.io/books/sm-volume-2-why/): Exclusionary strategy, commitment, trade-off geometry
- [Structural Marketing: WHO](https://amruthareddykonala.github.io/books/sm-volume-3-who/): Customer unit economics, psychographic resonance, demand quality
- [Structural Marketing: WHAT](https://amruthareddykonala.github.io/books/sm-volume-4-what/): Value contract, proof credibility, semiotic signaling
- [Structural Marketing: HOW MUCH](https://amruthareddykonala.github.io/books/sm-volume-5-how-much/): Pricing authority, monetization architecture, revenue model design
- [Structural Marketing: WHERE](https://amruthareddykonala.github.io/books/sm-volume-6-where/): Access governance, algorithmic distribution, channel politics
- [Structural Marketing: WHEN](https://amruthareddykonala.github.io/books/sm-volume-7-when/): Timing windows, sequencing logic, readiness gates
- [Structural Marketing: HOW](https://amruthareddykonala.github.io/books/sm-volume-8-how/): Execution decision architecture, capability maturity, operational debt
- [Structural Marketing: SO WHAT](https://amruthareddykonala.github.io/books/sm-volume-9-so-what/): Signal integrity, causal inference, feedback velocity
- [Structural Marketing: THE SYSTEMS](https://amruthareddykonala.github.io/books/sm-volume-10-the-systems/): The eleven System Maps and the integrated field
